title: P0.33: UIBridge queued message dispatch hardening
description: Live proof after P0.33 showed UIBridge listening but send_message reached bridge_chat_queued without bridge_chat_dispatched. The bridge now uses QMetaObject.invokeMethod with QueuedConnection first and falls back to the existing Qt signal.
resume_hint: Completed in local Windows runtime. send_message_from_bridge returns dispatch_method so queued-vs-dispatched issues remain auditable.
next_action: After restart, send a UIBridge chat message and verify bridge_chat_queued is followed by bridge_chat_dispatched.
reason: A runtime bridge that accepts messages but does not dispatch them creates a blind spot in automated live proof and external audit. This is an observability transport fix, not a routing decision.
